name: Stock Report based on variants
query:
SELECT 
    i.item_code AS `Item Code`, 
    iv.name AS `Variant Item`,
    it.item_name AS `Variant Name`,
    b.actual_qty AS `Stock Quantity`,
    b.warehouse AS `Warehouse`
FROM 
    `tabItem` i
JOIN 
    `tabItem Variant` iv ON i.item_code = iv.parent
JOIN
    `tabItem` it ON iv.name = it.item_code
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabBin` b ON iv.name = b.item_code
WHERE 
    i.item_code = %(item_code)s
ORDER BY 
    iv.name;
